name: GHGSat landfill-null Sentinel-2/Landsat exact-time catalog audit
research_question: Do the independently qualified GHGSat C1/C2 reviewed null observations yield at least 28 distinct, MARS-disjoint source observations with exact Sentinel-2 L1C or Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-1 point coverage within one hour?

decision_context_disclosed_before_freeze.anti_pooling_boundary: GHGSat must yield at least 28 distinct qualifying source observations by itself. No failed STARCOP, CACH4, COVID/Permian, or Carbon Mapper row may contribute to this gate.
decision_context_disclosed_before_freeze.outcome_blindness: No target catalog response, target asset, local observability result, model output, MARS development outcome, or official benchmark outcome has been inspected for this source before freeze.

source_observation_contract.eligible_for_target_catalog_explanation: The metadata audit intentionally left this false because it did not itself authorize a query. This committed protocol supplies that authorization for the exact 176 hash-bound rows only.
source_observation_contract.label_claim: No localized plume detected at the reviewed waste site above applicable GHGSat sensitivity in the clear-sky C1/C2 observation; not physical zero and not a dense target mask.

query_contract.geometry: Exact WGS84 Point at the frozen site representative.
query_contract.datetime_window: Closed interval from source UTC minus 1 hour through source UTC plus 1 hour.
query_contract.fields_extension: Include only required item metadata and exclude assets and links where supported.
query_contract.checkpointing: Each exact request and hash of its accepted response is append-only under the ignored root. A resume may skip only a request whose canonical request hash and accepted response receipt both match.
response_validation: response is a valid STAC FeatureCollection
every retained item belongs to the exact requested collection and allowed platform
item datetime is finite UTC and within the closed one-hour interval
full item geometry, not only bbox, contains or touches the frozen point
cloud cover is finite in [0,100] but is not an eligibility threshold
no asset URL or raster content is retained

candidate_and_selection_contract.candidate: A valid catalog item satisfying every catalog and response rule for one frozen source observation.
selection_order_within_target_sensor: smallest absolute source-target time offset in seconds
candidate_and_selection_contract.cross_sensor_policy: Sentinel-2 and Landsat selections are both retained when independently present. Gates count distinct GHGSat source observations separately from total source-sensor pairs so a dual-sensor match cannot manufacture source-event headroom.
candidate_and_selection_contract.duplicate_target_policy: A target item may cover multiple reviewed sites, but each source-observation/target-sensor pair is unique and all later sampling/bootstrap grouping remains at least source observation, site, and 25 km component aware.
candidate_and_selection_contract.catalog_cloud_policy: Cloud cover is recorded and used only as a deterministic tie-breaker. Local crop observability and cloud/QA validity are deferred to the separately frozen windowed-asset protocol; unobservable crops can never become negatives.

failure_action: Retire GHGSat as the missing-negative pairing source without changing a threshold, widening the one-hour window, accepting L2 products, relaxing Landsat T1/L1TP, or pooling a failed source.
pass_action: Commit a separate exact target/reference item manifest and windowed-asset/local-observability protocol before requesting any raster asset or designing the model experiment.

permitted: the two exact public STAC search endpoints
metadata-only POST responses for the 176 hash-bound observations
HTTP headers and retry metadata needed to validate those responses
forbidden: any Sentinel-2 or Landsat raster, preview, thumbnail, tile metadata asset, QA band, or band URL fetch
any GHGSat raster or plume asset
any reference-scene catalog query outside the exact current-target one-hour window
any protected MARS outcome, mask, prediction, score, threshold, checkpoint, fold 0/1/2 result, or official benchmark result
any location coordinate as a model feature

claim_boundary: A PASS establishes public target-catalog timing and footprint feasibility only. It does not establish local clear-sky observability, valid six-band current/reference crops, dense labels, training value, calibration, generalization, or superiority over MARS-S2L.
